stem.text: A spring has spring constant $k$. The spring obeys Hooke’s law and experiences extension $x$ when a force $F$ is applied to it. The resulting elastic potential energy of the spring is $E_\text{P}$.
The diagram shows two of these springs joined together in parallel and hanging from a fixed beam.

stem.alt: Diagram of two springs joined together at their lower ends and hanging from a fixed beam, with a downward arrow labelled F below the joined ends. The label spring has a leader line to one of the springs.

stem.text: What is the extension and total elastic potential energy of this arrangement when the same force $F$ is applied?
